purpose: Read-time correction rules for country_code values written by the GDELT lane before the FIPS/ISO map fix (commit b7ab7def). The hot table signals_v2 was mutated directly (see ledgers/); everything derived from the immutable external archive (/Volumes/Ext/Atlas gzip partitions, historical_topic_country_daily, historical_evidence_samples) must apply these rules AT READ OR ETL TIME instead — mutating archive-derived tables would be undone by any re-ETL from the uncorrected archive.

applies_to.lane: source_family = 'gdelt' (attribution_method gdelt_gkg / gdelt_gkg_translated). RSS/NewsData/social lanes write ISO directly and were never affected.
applies_to.exclude_rows: geo_confidence = 0.35 — the ingest outlet_origin_override path (ingest_v2._GEO_OVERRIDE_CONFIDENCE) writes ISO codes derived from the outlet ccTLD/domain, not FIPS; those rows are already correct (measured: all 82 conf-0.35 rows in the PA bucket are genuine Panama).
applies_to.valid_from: 2025-12-04 (map inception, commit b0ac1a56 — the wrong/missing entries were present from the first version; the 2026-06 #235 alias fix cc68e3ef covered only AJ/RI/BK/MJ/IC/YM and backfilled them itself)
applies_to.valid_until: the moment commit b7ab7def reaches prod ingest (NOT yet deployed as of 2026-07-28; update this field at deploy time)

remap_semantics: Single hop from the STORED code: a stored 'MN' becomes 'MC' and stops — never chained onward to 'MO'. Chains exist (BP→SB→PM→PA→PY, MG→MN→MC→MO, GK→GG→GE, AY→AQ→AS, ...) because each stored code was produced by a DIFFERENT FIPS input; apply the map exactly once per row.

special_cases.LS: FIPS LS (Liechtenstein) also passed through into this bucket alongside the mis-mapped Lebanon rows. Rows whose headline matches /liechtenstein|vaduz/i go to LI, all others to LB (measured 5 vs 1870 in the 7d window).

contaminated_do_not_remap.CN: China (via FIPS CH) + Comoros (GEC CN passthrough)
contaminated_do_not_remap.GB: United Kingdom (via FIPS UK) + Gabon (GEC GB passthrough)
contaminated_do_not_remap.PL: Poland (identity) + Portugal (old map sent FIPS PO to PL)
contaminated_do_not_remap.ZA: South Africa (via FIPS SF) + Zambia (old map sent FIPS ZA to ZA)
contaminated_do_not_remap.MA: Morocco (via FIPS MO, correct) + Madagascar (GEC MA passthrough)
contaminated_do_not_remap.LT: Lithuania (via FIPS LH) + Lesotho (GEC LT passthrough)
contaminated_do_not_remap.TD: Chad (via FIPS CD, correct) + Trinidad and Tobago (GEC TD passthrough)
contaminated_do_not_remap.PS: Palestine (via GZ/WE, correct) + Palau (GEC PS passthrough)
contaminated_do_not_remap.note: These buckets mix two countries under one stored code; splitting them requires re-deriving geography from raw GDELT V2ENHANCEDLOCATIONS in the archive, not a code remap.

identified_but_unmapped.OS: GDELT GEC 'Oceans' pseudo-code (verified by sample: Caspian, Black Sea, Baltic, Adriatic, Odesa-port stories). No ISO equivalent; not a country.
identified_but_unmapped.YI: GEC Serbia-and-Montenegro (defunct 2006). Content is pan-Yugoslav retrospective/nostalgia; no honest successor code.
identified_but_unmapped.CR: Bucket is 100% geo_confidence-0.35 override rows = correct Costa Rica. Nothing to fix.
identified_but_unmapped.TK: 24 rows GDELT-geocoded (conf 0.85, coordinates) whose content is Turkey — GDELT geocoder pathology. Neither TK (ISO Tokelau) nor TC (Turks and Caicos) is honest; left as-is.
